_source: March Targets V1 — budget and KPI data from StoreHub internal targets sheet (March 2026). Platform specs from StoreHub Brand Guideline.
_note: StoreHub runs acquisition campaigns across MY/PH/TH targeting F&B and retail SME owners
cta_variants: See it in action — book a free demo

cta_by_language.TH: ทดลองฟรี demo

cta_rationale: All ads drive to a free demo booking where a Business Consultant visits the merchant in person. CTA must feel low-friction (free) and high-value (demo = see it working, not just hear about it).

funnel_stages.MQL: Marketing Qualified Lead — passed initial quality filter
funnel_stages.SQL: Sales Qualified Lead — BC confirmed appointment

MY.notes: Largest market. Highest close rate. English = Win%, Chinese = SQL%, Malay = volume.

PH.notes: Second market. Lower CPL target than MY (RM100 vs RM125). Similar SQL% target. Lower close rate than MY.

TH.notes: Smallest market. Highest CPL target (RM130) and highest CPWon (RM2019). Lowest SQL% target (20%) — leads are lower intent or market is earlier stage. MC>Won rate (80%) is highest of all markets.

meta.monthly_budget_note: Majority of RM618k total — split across MY/PH/TH per market_targets above

linkedin.notes: Not currently used — StoreHub is B2SMB not enterprise B2B

kill_threshold.note: Kill any ad with CPL >50% above market target OR SQL% <50% of target after 1000+ impressions
